issues.issue: Unexplained local receipts recorded as other: 63% of the year's receipts (19,828 of 31,330). The review note says 40%, but that is the share of total resources including the beginning balance. For an SID this is likely special assessments, but the form gives no breakdown.
No function is printed. The extractor rules give no function for SID operating expenses, so general government is an assumption.

The line doesn't say whether this is principal, interest or fees. 20,633 is large next to 13,498 of operating expenses, which suggests it includes principal (warrant/bond retirement). Interest (fees/bond maintenance) is an assumption.
